# Trial outcome measures as evidence (generated by experiments/fetch_clinicaltrials_outcomes.py — do not edit by hand)

Generated by `experiments/fetch_clinicaltrials_outcomes.py` on 2026-10-16 at commit d0e8b1e-dirty from ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (data/raw/clinicaltrials_outcomes), data/processed/evidence_full_v4, configs/trial_outcome_scale_crosswalk.csv; do not edit by hand.

Source `ClinicalTrials-outcomes` at the fine level: 222 study drugs queried; 12,969 studies with posted results; 98,072 outcome measures, 6,954 on a crosswalked scale, 1,177 of those with a drug arm and a placebo arm that could be told apart, 874 read as a mean comparison: **231 relief**, **58 worsening**, **11 no effect** (standardised interval within 0.2 of 0) and 574 undecided (in clinical_trial_outcome_comparisons.parquet with report_value -1, never in the report table).

A relief is relation `relieves` with report_value 1, a worsening is `induces` 1, a no-effect is `relieves` 0. Class human_association, grade C: a soft prior, never a label. A total score that fuses several constructs (PANSS total, an ADHD total) matches no rule and is not read; the subscales are.
